svg.title: Daniel Nilsson
svg.desc: Daniel Nilsson — exploratory developer and drummer, Göteborg. The name in heavy condensed type beside a wheel drawn in text characters, turning, with one neon magenta spoke that has broken free of the rim. Four lines: now, innovation developer at Quokka; build, LLM pipelines, end to end; free, Neon Sumi, a status line for Claude Code; drums, seventeen years, recorded, never quantized.
